plugins.name: jira
plugins.description: JIRA task creator for any software project

plugins.name: utils
plugins.description: Utility helpers for common development workflows

plugins.name: personas
plugins.description: Conversational persona skills — consult specific personas on topics they know deeply

plugins.name: dataforseo
plugins.description: SEO research via the DataForSEO API v3 — keyword research, competitor & domain analysis, SERP/rank checking, and backlink analysis

plugins.name: project-docs
plugins.description: Spec/ADR/plan documentation system — scaffold it, keep it in sync with the code, read the plan back as one table, optionally mirror it to GitHub Issues, and write it so a human reads it fast

plugins.name: payload-cms
plugins.description: Read and write Payload CMS content over the REST API — discovers each project's collections, blocks and locales at runtime, composes blocks and Lexical rich text, uploads media, and guards every write with a backup, a diff and a re-read

plugins.name: qa
plugins.description: Manual QA through a browser — scenarios derived from the ticket and the diff, written down as a scenario file, executed by Playwright (visible or headless) or in the user's own Chrome, every screenshot captioned with what it proves, reported as a pass/fail table with reproduction steps

plugins.name: pair
plugins.description: Pair programming across two Claude Code tabs — one session drives and writes the code step by step, the other navigates and reviews the plan and every step, talking through cross-session messages
